positions.title: Consultant - Kforce

positions.title: Contractor - Senior Oracle Developer
positions.description: Experienced and versatile developer, working with large systems and dispersed teams.  Skilled in systems integration, data modeling concepts, business and data analysis, migration/Extraction/Transformation/Loading of data,  query writing, integration testing, problem solving leadership, team training and end user support. Worked on data intensive time critical systems.  Proactive, organized, creative thinker and out of the box problem solver.

positions.title: Senior Oracle Analyst Programmer Developer
positions.description: I am a technically sophisticated developer analyst with solid experience using Oracle, PL/SQL, and Unix to do everything from migrating and converting data to extracting, transforming, or loading data sets. As a seasoned Oracle PL/SQL Developer, I am skilled in project coordination and query writing and have a penchant for Business Interpretation and Process Evaluation. I have a motivational leadership style that is self-motivated and adept at prioritizing an enormously large workload into manageable tasks that can be completed according to schedule. If you need some consolatory type work I can be reached at anitapatelmolit@gmail.com

positions.title: Senior Oracle Developer
positions.description:
Worked closely in an EDI group related to developing EDI messages for one of the largest shipping conglomerates in the worlds. Developed messages related to Booking Request, Shipping Instruction, Cargo Tracking, Purchase Order, Rail Bill, Customs Manifest, Inbond Arrival, Customs Clearance, and Freight Clearance. Created modules involved in Vessel Scheduling, Booking, Bill of Landing, Container Transaction, and Intermodal Transportation. Participated in requirement gathering and the writing of the design specification document. Performed Data Analysis, Data Migration, Data Conversion, and Extraction/Transformation/Loading of data into current databases and remote ones. Key Accomplishments: 
* Identified the location of a significant delay in the container tracking system through rigorous analysis and improved KPI almost immediately. 
* Enhanced the daily data cleanup process for better performance and to reduce data resource. 
* Developed various Crystal Reports to reduce the manual man power on frequently used queries. 
* Pioneered a daily data purge routine and optimized performance using dynamic SQL, PL/SQL, DBMS_STATA, DBMS SQL, UTL FILE, and UNIX 
* Elected to serve as IT lead for the design, data modeling development, and implementation of various EDI solutions. 
* Gained hand-on experience in the scheduling and managing of batch processes using UNIX shell script. 
* Developed backend process using complex SQL queries, PL/SQL store procedures, Packages, Functions, and Database Triggers. 
* Created comprehensive integration test strategies and plans to gather data related to database impacts, risk assessment, functional scenarios, and usability.

positions.title: Oracle Programmer and Developer
positions.description: Was an instrumental part of the EDI project, helping to get the data to and from the customers to and from the Booking, Receiving, Documentation, and Claims modules.

skills.name: Oracle11g/10g/9i/8i, PL/SQL Developer, TOAD, SQL, SQL*Plus, .Net, Crystal Reports, Java, Pythos, Mongo DB, R, XML, VMS, PRO*C, Forms and Reports 6i/4.5, MS Excel, MS Visio, SQL Server, Ultra Edit, LINQ Pad4, HTML, PVCS, Citrix, DOS, Windows, UNIX
